title: carex ferruginea var. sempervirens
intro: Carex ferruginea var. sempervirens, commonly known as Red Sedge, is a perennial sedge species. This plant has been used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and bronchitis due to its health benefits. Therapeutically, Red Sedge is used for its expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic actions, making it effective in relieving respiratory issues and wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Red Sedge include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
